content.text:
Why Micron Isn’t Buying Back Stock—and Why It Could
Memory-chip companies are buying back stock hand over fist. But don’t hold your breath if you are a shareholder of Micron Technology. The U.S. company will have to wait until at least the end of this year to do the same.
